name: Northwest Coast Art Kitchen Towel
where: Bill Reid Gallery shop or craft shops on Granville Island
about: A kitchen towel printed with designs in the Northwest Coast Indigenous art style, which is closely tied to Vancouver's region and its First Nations artists. The Bill Reid Gallery is dedicated to this art, so the towel fits the city well.
tip: Choose items with the artist's name and a license printed on them. Check the country of manufacture before you buy, since it is not always listed.
